pages.article_html:
Party Crasher

Level 4 · Diplomacy · New Targonor · Thestra

Near a park bench in the Remniol District.

Objectives

Convince Larinia Remniol to give you Jenia Remniol's meeting supplies. Convince a Heartsworn to crash the meeting with you. Return to Jan Pentago when complete. - Convince Duchess Remniol To Give You Jenia's Mask - Incite Sir Kerrick to Crash Meeting - Crash the Meeting with the Heartsworns - Jenia Remniol's Mask (0/1)

Description

Thinking to yourself, you realize that Jenia isn't ready for this meeting that is about to take place. You might be able to get her things from inside the house and pose as her to crash the meeting. Bringing along some Heartsworn knights would also ensure that the meeting never finishes.

What they say

On taking it

Jenia Remniol
Thinking to yourself, you realize that Jenia isn't ready for this meeting that is about to take place. You might be able to get her things from inside the house and pose as her to crash the meeting. Bringing along some Heartsworn knights would also ensure that the meeting never finishes.

findings.observation: Heading displays Level 4, Diplomacy, New Targonor, Thestra and near a park bench in the Remniol District. Details starter location is -36775, 26835, 36056. Notes separately place Duchess Larinia Remniol in Lamplighters District, Sir Kerrick Ostwitch in Knights Rest, and Theron in Griffon Area. Preserve distinct contexts without verified spawns or coordinate units.

Primary prose objectives require convincing Larinia, convincing a Heartsworn and returning to Jan Pentago. Tracker lines separately name Duchess Remniol, Sir Kerrick, crashing the meeting and Jenia Remniols Mask (0/1). The fandom account shows Mask (1) and adds arriving disguised and gossiping with attendees. Preserve all accounts; the displayed counter is not evidence of an acquired item or a complete executable quest script.

Notes place Duchess Larinia at -35607, 26167, 36134, Sir Kerrick Ostwitch at -61038, 26853, 36531 and Theron at -46875, 6826, 36438. Notes say winning the Duchess parley gets the mask, then direct the player to Knights Rest and the secret meeting, name Ebon, Theron, Markov, Heron and Miri, report a battle, and direct return to Jan. These are attributed instructions, not verified spawn or combat mechanics.

Three unrendered galleries contain four card filenames each, retained in full article markup. Repeated Party Crasher :4 text has unresolved semantics. Filenames do not establish canonical card IDs, rewards or complete encounter decks.

Five disagreements are printed: ends npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), loc (fandom), next quest (fandom), next quest (silkyvenom), prev quest (silkyvenom). Alternative values are not all displayed. Details names Jenia as starter and Jan as hand-in; prose return instructions agree with Jan but do not resolve the attributed ends-npc conflict.

Details prints Previous Alley Whispers or The Inner Eye of Wisdom or Word on the Street, and Next Back The Beginning, To The Mountains Base, Back To The Spring, Returning to the Source, Interwoven Threads (exact spellings retained in evidence). Links do not establish enforced prerequisites or required branch order. Repeatable yes and Coin reward 0 do not establish eligibility or denomination.

Taking dialogue is attributed to wiki.silkyvenom.com; alternate objectives are attributed to fandom; Source links the MMODB emulator archive mirror. Original linked pages were not fetched this phase. Mirrored Telonica provenance is not independent corroboration.
